import itertools,json,sympy as s
from canonical_ground_parent_singlet_20261012 import wedge_action,complementary_singlet
I=s.eye(6);I216=s.eye(216);pair=complementary_singlet(4,2);J=s.kronecker_product(pair/s.sqrt(6),I)
assert J.H*J==I
Ts=[]
for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(4),2):
 t=s.zeros(4);t[i,j]=t[j,i]=s.Rational(1,2);Ts.append(t)
 t=s.zeros(4);t[i,j]=-s.I/2;t[j,i]=s.I/2;Ts.append(t)
Ts += [s.diag(1,-1,0,0)/2,s.diag(1,1,-2,0)/(2*s.sqrt(3)),s.diag(1,1,1,-3)/(2*s.sqrt(6))]
def collective(t):
 a=s.SparseMatrix(wedge_action(t,2))
 return s.SparseMatrix(s.kronecker_product(a,I,I)+s.kronecker_product(I,a,I)+s.kronecker_product(I,I,a))
C=s.SparseMatrix(216,216,{})
for t in Ts:
 assert s.trace(t*t)==s.Rational(1,2)
 G=collective(t);assert G*J==J*wedge_action(t,2);C+=G*G
C=s.SparseMatrix(C.applyfunc(s.simplify))
other=[s.Rational(9,2),s.Rational(15,2),s.Rational(21,2)];c=s.Rational(5,2)
P=s.SparseMatrix(I216)
for z in other:P=P*(C-z*I216)/(c-z)
P=s.SparseMatrix(P.applyfunc(s.simplify))
assert P*P==P and P.H==P and C*P==c*P and s.trace(P)==18
rows=[]
for i in range(4):
 e=s.zeros(4);e[i,i]=1;N=collective(e)
 assert N*J==J*(I+wedge_action(e,2))
 assert (N-I216)*(N-2*I216)*P==s.zeros(216)
 rows.append({'mode':i,'restricted_aux_number_spectrum':[1,2]})
print(json.dumps({'kind':'EXACT_AUXILIARY_THREE_COPY_FULL216_SCHUR_REDUCTION_NOT_NATIVE63_GROUND','full_dimension':216,'R_isotypic_dimension':18,'R_dimension':6,'all_multiplicities':3,'paired_embedding_dimension':6,'wrong_unique_pair_embedding_equals_full_sector_rejected':True,'normalized_SU4_generators':15,'trace_shift_per_mode':1,'restricted_collective_number':rows,'general63':{'embedding':'31 complementary singlet pairs plus one free wedge^k factor','collective_action':'31Tr(K)I+dGamma_R(K)','per_mode_number_spectrum':[31,32],'first4_others60_empty_occupation_orthogonal':True},'numerical_native_ground_or_phase':False},sort_keys=True))
